dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agency personnel, public safety communications administrators, and emergency responders through agency management and oversight.
dimensions.evidence: This bill provides statutory authority for the Office of Public Safety Communications within the National Telecommunications and Information Administration

dimensions.assessment: Effects are primarily administrative, organizing federal duties, audits, and oversight for existing public safety communications programs.
dimensions.evidence: The duties of the office include (1) administering federal grant programs for Next Generation 9-1-1 systems... and (2) managing and auditing the First Responder Network Authority

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal appropriations or revenue changes.
Amends the National Telecommunications and Information Administration Organization Act to establish a new office and outline specific administrative and auditing duties.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the National Telecommunications and Information Administration Organization Act to establish the Office of Public Safety Communications

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory authority and ongoing annual auditing requirements for federal public safety networks.
dimensions.evidence: shall annually conduct an audit of the activities of the First Responder Network Authority

importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes an Office of Public Safety Communications within the NTIA to oversee federal grant programs for Next Generation 9-1-1 and manage the First Responder Network Authority, creating administrative structures and duties without large spending allocations.
